scope: R58 frozen three historical targets; source-code-only audit, no target rows or production host access

workflow_build.description: ROLEPLAY_BUILD_SHA is set to github.sha for CI Next.js build
workflow_build.limitation: The workflow file establishes intended build behavior, not that it executed for the historical target.

github_actions_deploy.description: Deployment staging directory includes Github SHA, run ID and attempt; deploy script invoked with github.sha.
github_actions_deploy.limitation: Staging name and workflow source alone do not establish successful release or target-time active backend.

deployed_sha_marker.description: Records current successful deployment to DEPLOYED_SHA after checks.

deployment_status.description: Per-staging transaction status can report succeeded or failed and source SHA if retained.

retention_policy.note: Old staging beyond both count and age is eligible for cleanup, so absence cannot prove no historical deploy.

local_deployer.description: Owner local deployment checks remote DEPLOYED_SHA and a public build version prefix after success.

evidence_recovery.priority: Look for already retained, authoritative deployment transaction receipts, successful stage deploy.status and full SHA with trusted deploy times, then independently bind to each frozen target's generation time and active app/PM2 revision.
evidence_recovery.requests_to_owner: Share only SAFE aggregate: historic_receipt_exists, full_sha_pinned, trusted_interval_covers_each_target, host_role_verified, runtime_was_active and evidence_source_class. Never upload SSH credentials, private paths, logs, message IDs, user details or unredacted env.
